title: 5 Advanced English Words With Meanings #shorts
description:
5 advanced English words with meanings: ambiguous, benevolent, cautious, inevitable and reluctant, each with a short, simple definition.
If you know these 5 words, your English is advanced:
• Ambiguous: with more than one meaning
• Benevolent: kind and generous
• Cautious: careful to avoid danger
• Inevitable: sure to happen
• Reluctant: not wanting to do something

How many did you know? Write your score in the comments.
